entities.name: Group B streptococcal colonization
observations: A positive vaginal-rectal GBS screen identifies maternal colonization and ordinarily prompts intrapartum prophylaxis when labor or membrane rupture occurs.
For a planned cesarean performed before labor onset with intact membranes, GBS-specific intrapartum prophylaxis is not indicated.

entities.name: Planned cesarean delivery
observations: Routine perioperative antibiotic prophylaxis is indicated for cesarean delivery regardless of maternal GBS colonization status.

entities.name: No GBS prophylaxis before cesarean
observations: In a GBS-positive patient undergoing prelabor cesarean with intact membranes, administer standard cesarean preoperative antibiotics but not additional GBS-specific intrapartum penicillin.
